body.zh-Hant: 大隈重信生於天保9年（1838年），出身佐賀藩。1873年他任大藏省事務總裁，並兼參議、大藏卿。1881年因明治十四年政變被免職、下野；1882年3月他結成立憲改進黨並擔任總裁，同年9月創立東京專門學校。
body.en: Ōkuma Shigenobu was born in 1838 (Tenpō 9) and came from the Saga domain. In 1873 he became chief of the Ministry of Finance affairs and also held the posts of councillor and finance minister. He was dismissed and left government in the political crisis of 1881; in March 1882 he founded the Rikken Kaishintō as its president, and in September of that year he established the Tokyo Senmon Gakkō.

heading.zh-Hant: 外務大臣、首相與早稻田總長
heading.en: Foreign minister, first premiership and Waseda presidency

body.zh-Hant: 1888年2月至1889年12月，他任第1次伊藤內閣、黑田內閣的外務大臣；1896年9月至1897年11月任第2次松方內閣外務大臣，1897年3月至11月兼農商務大臣。1898年6月至11月出任內閣總理大臣。1900年8月至1907年1月任憲政本黨總理，1907年4月就任早稻田大學總長。
body.en: From February 1888 to December 1889 he was foreign minister in the first Itō cabinet and the Kuroda cabinet; from September 1896 to November 1897 he was foreign minister in the second Matsukata cabinet, and from March to November 1897 he also held the agriculture and commerce portfolio. From June to November 1898 he served as prime minister. He was president of the Kenseihontō from August 1900 to January 1907, and in April 1907 he became president of Waseda University.

citations.quote: 1888.2～89.12第1次伊藤内閣・黒田内閣外務大臣
1896.9～97.11第2次松方内閣外務大臣
1897.3～11兼農商務大臣

body.zh-Hant: 1914年4月16日第2次大隈內閣成立，他以首相身分兼任內務大臣。第一次世界大戰期間，他提出對華二十一條要求。1915年8月10日起他又兼任外務大臣，至同年10月13日由石井菊次郎接任。內閣於1916年10月總辭，首相任期止於1916年10月9日。
body.en: The second Ōkuma cabinet was formed on 16 April 1914, and he served as prime minister while also holding the Home Ministry. During the First World War his government presented the Twenty-One Demands to China. From 10 August 1915 he also held the Foreign Ministry concurrently until Ishii Kikujirō took it over on 13 October of that year. The cabinet resigned in October 1916, and his term as prime minister ended on 9 October 1916.

body.zh-Hant: 1916年7月他獲封侯爵並任貴族院議員。1922年1月10日他去世，終年83歲，同月17日在日比谷公園舉行葬禮，採取國民葬形式，據稱是日本首次國民葬。
body.en: In July 1916 he was made a marquis and became a member of the House of Peers. He died on 10 January 1922 at the age of 83, and his funeral was held at Hibiya Park on the 17th of that month in the form of a national funeral, said to be the first in Japan.

body.zh-Hant: 布施（Germán Busch Becerra）的父親是一位性情古怪的德籍醫師，母親名拉蓋爾·貝塞拉（Raquel Becerra）。他年輕時就以軍校生身分入伍，以勇敢、體魄與火爆脾氣聞名。有論文註記他的公共生涯共11年，從1928年起至1939年止。
body.en: Germán Busch Becerra's father was an eccentric German medical doctor and his mother was Raquel Becerra. In his early youth he joined the army as a cadet, and he became noted for his daring, physical fitness and hot temper. A scholarly article notes that his public life lasted eleven years, from 1928 to 1939.

his mother, Raquel Becerra

He became noted for his daring, physical fitness, and hot temper
Su vida pública es de 11 años: 1928-1939.

body.zh-Hant: 玻利維亞與巴拉圭的查科戰爭，戰事階段為1932至1935年。布施以查科戰爭中的軍人表現被視為玻利維亞英雄，他的勇敢與脾氣在戰爭中派上用場。
body.en: The Chaco War between Bolivia and Paraguay had a military phase (1932-1935). Busch is regarded as a Bolivian hero for his conduct as a soldier in the Chaco War, where his daring and temper served him well.

body.zh-Hant: 布施參與了推翻薩拉曼卡（Daniel Salamanca）、特哈達·索爾薩諾（José Luis Tejada Sorzano）與托羅（David Toro）三位總統的行動。1937年7月他就任總統，理由是他認為前三位總統處理戰爭都很無能。1938年5月27日他被選為1938至1942年任期的憲法總統。
body.en: Busch took part in the overthrow of Presidents Daniel Salamanca, José Luis Tejada Sorzano and David Toro. In July 1937 he assumed the presidency, believing that all three of his predecessors had been inept in their handling of the war. On 27 May 1938 he was elected constitutional president for the period 1938 to 1942.

citations.quote: After participating in the overthrow of presidents Daniel Salamanca
José Luis Tejada Sorzano, and David Toro
in July 1937 he assumed the presidency
all three previous presidents had been inept in their handling of the war
On 27 May 1938 Busch was elected constitutional president
for the period 1938 to 1942

body.zh-Hant: 1938年他頒布了先進的憲法，並頒布首部勞動法典。1939年4月24日他自立為獨裁者，其措施包括將標準石油資產國有化。他判處德裔錫業大亨霍希爾德（Mauricio Hochschild）死刑並將錫礦國有化，但內閣阻止行刑；1939年8月23日他在隨從面前自殺。
body.en: In 1938 he enacted an advanced constitution and issued the first labour code. On 24 April 1939 he declared himself dictator, and his measures included the nationalization of the Standard Oil holdings. He condemned the German-born tin magnate Mauricio Hochschild to death and nationalized the tin mines, but his cabinet prevented the execution; on 23 August 1939 he killed himself in front of his aides.

heading.en: Heads of government under the military dictatorship

body.zh-Hant: 葡萄牙在1926年5月30日至1933年4月11日處於軍事獨裁。這段期間的政府首腦先後有卡爾莫納、維森特·德·弗雷塔斯與伊文斯·費拉斯（Ivens Ferraz）等人，1930年1月21日起由將軍多明戈斯·德·奧利韋拉接任。
body.en: Portugal lived under a military dictatorship from 30 May 1926 to 11 April 1933. The heads of government in this period included Óscar Carmona, Vicente de Freitas and General Ivens Ferraz, and from 21 January 1930 the post passed to General Domingos de Oliveira.

citations.quote: De 30 de Maio de 1926 a 11 de Abril de 1933
Portugal viveu em ditadura militar
Óscar Carmona (chefe do governo de 9 de Julho de 1926 a 18 de Abril de 1928)
coronel Vicente de Freitas
e pelos generais Ivens Ferraz
e Domingos de Oliveira (de 21 de Janeiro de 1930 a 5 de Julho de 1932)

heading.en: President of the Council of Ministers

body.zh-Hant: 奧利韋拉於1930年1月21日起主持政府，至1932年7月5日止。他是接替伊文斯·費拉斯出任此職的人；繼任者是薩拉查（Salazar）。
body.en: Oliveira headed the government from 21 January 1930 to 5 July 1932. He took over from Ivens Ferraz, and Salazar succeeded him.

citations.quote: e Domingos de Oliveira (de 21 de Janeiro de 1930 a 5 de Julho de 1932)
a substituição do referido Ivens Ferraz por Domingos de Oliveira
A este sucedeu Salazar

body.zh-Hant: 總統府歷史檔案館的檔案將他標示為「將軍、部長會議主席」。檔案內含1931年4月9日的塔與劍軍事勳章大十字授予證書，授予令於1931年4月11日刊登在政府公報第83期。
body.en: The archive of the Presidency of the Republic describes him as "General, Presidente do Ministério". The file contains a certificate of the Grand Cross of the Military Order of the Tower and Sword dated 9 April 1931, and the decree of award was published in the Diário do Governo, no. 83, on 11 April 1931.

de 9 de abril de 1931
publicado no Diário do Governo, n.º 83, de 11 de abril de 1931
